origin.birthplace: The Wycliffe estate near the capital
origin.socialStatus: A rich heir of a merchant family that bought its nobility
origin.profession: Heir who has never worked; studied mathematics and bookkeeping

appearance.face: A young, pale, smooth face; bites his lips
appearance.hairAndEyes: Curly blond hair, frightened blue eyes
appearance.clothing: Expensive clothes that do not fit him, a purse pressed to his chest, a small ledger
appearance.build: Thin, hunched, sits on the edge of the chair
appearance.gestures: Calculates in his head and moves his lips; glances at the door
appearance.voice: A quiet, unsure voice; stammers under pressure
appearance.firstImpression: A frightened rich boy who should not be here
appearance.artistNotes: In the ledger he keeps an exact record of every stake at the table. Wears his father's ring, which is too big for him.

backstory.biography: Thomas is the only son of a rich merchant who bought a noble title. His father decided everything for him. A month ago his father died and Thomas inherited a vast fortune and many enemies. He does not know whom to trust. He is clever and excellent with numbers, but has no courage to make a decision.
backstory.whyHere: His uncle (who wants the inheritance) sent him "to learn to be a man". Thomas suspects his uncle wants him to lose everything.
backstory.secret: That he is cleverer than he shows and keeps a full account of everyone at the table.

psychology.regret: That he was never good enough for his father
psychology.wouldForReward: Betray anyone if he feels in danger

behavior.deception: Does not use it, but recognises it in the numbers
behavior.debts: Hates owing and pays at once
behavior.alliances: Looks for a protector and gets strongly attached
behavior.whenAttacks: Only when the numbers are clearly in his favour
behavior.whenRetreats: At the first sign of danger or threat
behavior.onLoss: Panics and wants to leave the table
behavior.onWin: Relief and gratitude to his protector
behavior.strategyChange: If his protector abandons him or someone threatens him

motives.hiddenGoal: To find a protector he can trust

speech.register: Unsure, polite, sometimes precise with numbers

mechanics.strangeness: His father's ring is far too big, yet it never falls off — however much his hand shakes.
mechanics.ability: The Bookkeeper: sees the full list of every gift announced tonight and who received it.
mechanics.hostRelation: Fear — the strongest at the table.

authorNotes.distinctive: A cowardly but clever character who can be a very useful ally.

lines.text: I… I'm Thomas. Wycliffe. Pleased to meet you.
I knew it… I knew this would happen.
No… I can't… it's too much.
Thomas Wycliffe, the heir. He trembles like a leaf — but watch his ledger, not his hands.

tells.description: Calculates in his head and moves his lips
